claims.text: Yes, the contract caps liability. For NETGEAR (and Bay Networks), total liability for damages in any action connected to the Agreement is capped, but the cap amount is redacted in the source as [*], so the sources do not state the figure.

citations.quote: IN NO EVENT WILL NETGEAR's OR BAY NETWORKS' TOTAL LIABILITY FOR ANY DAMAGES IN ANY ACTION BASED ON OR ARISING OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE AGREEMENT EXCEED THE [*] TO NETGEAR PURSUANT TO THE AGREEMENT.

claims.text: The Distributor also has a liability cap of the same redacted amount, measured by the same words.

citations.quote: IN NO EVENT WELL DISTRIBUTOR's TOTAL LIABILITY FOR ANY DAMAGES IN ANY ACTION BASED ON OR ARISING OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE AGREEMENT EXCEED THE [*] TO NETGEAR PURSUANT TO THE AGREEMENT.

claims.text: NETGEAR's cap does not apply to damages arising under Sections 14.A and 16.A.

citations.quote: EXCEPT FOR DAMAGES ARISING UNDER SECTIONS 14.A AND 16.A

claims.text: Section 14.A covers NETGEAR's defense and payment obligations for claims that a Product infringes intellectual property rights.

citations.quote: NETGEAR agrees to defend at its own expense any action brought against Distributor to the extent that it is based on a claim that any Product infringes a United States or Territory patent, copyright, trade mark, trade secret or other valid intellectual property right

claims.text: Section 16.A covers NETGEAR's indemnity for third-party claims attributable to bodily injury, death, or physical property damage, caused by NETGEAR's negligence or a material defect.

citations.quote: NETGEAR agrees to indemnify Distributor against any claim arising out of or resulting from the Products or the Agreement
(i) is attributable to bodily injury, death, or to injury to or destruction of physical property (other than the Products)

claims.text: The Distributor's cap does not apply to damages arising from breach of Sections 6.C, 12, 13, or 17.

citations.quote: EXCEPT FOR DAMAGES ARISING FROM BREACH OF SECTIONS 6.C AND 12,13 OR 17

claims.text: Separately from the cap, neither party is liable for the cost of substitute procurement, special, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, or for damages from inaccurate or lost data, or loss of use or profits.

citations.quote: IN NO EVENT WILL EITHER PARTY OR THEIR RESPECTIVE PARENT CORPORATIONS OR SUPPLIERS BE LIABLE FOR (1) THE COST OF SUBSTITUTE PROCUREMENT, SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES, OR (2) ANY DAMAGES RESULTING FROM INACCURATE OR LOST DATA OR LOSS OF USE OR PROFITS

claims.text: The source's carve-out language (Sections 14.A, 16.A, 6.C, 12, 13, 17) appears only in the cap sentences. The consequential-damages exclusion sentence does not itself state those carve-outs, so the sources do not say whether they apply to that exclusion.

citations.quote: EXCEPT FOR DAMAGES ARISING UNDER SECTIONS 14.A AND 16.A

claims.text: After expiration or early termination, no party owes the other any dollar amounts, costs, or damages by reason of that event, unless agreed in writing.

citations.quote: Except as expressly agreed in writing between the parties, no party is liable to the other for any dollar amounts, costs or damages by reason of the expiration or earlier termination of the Agreement.
